preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
Attacker must hold some MSA tokens to demonstrate the exploit
swapAndLiquifyEnabled should be true (default is false, but owner can enable it)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() to set both fees to high values (e.g., 49 each, totaling 98%). Then transfer tokens to the Uniswap pair to trigger the fee mechanism. The high fees will cause most of the transferred amount to be taken as fees (tax + liquidity), which will be swapped to BNB and sent to marketing address (controlled by owner) or added to liquidity (owned by owner). Enable swapAndLiquifyEnabled first if needed.
